intro.text: At Desert Forest, we believe privacy should be as straightforward as ordering your favourite cake. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we use it, how we protect it, who we may share it with, and the choices you have.
This policy applies when you visit the Desert Forest website, use our app, place an order, contact us, interact with us on WhatsApp or social media, or participate in our offers and campaigns.

sections.heading: What information does Desert Forest collect?

blocks.text: We collect information that helps us process your orders and provide a better experience. This may include:

items: Contact details: Your name, mobile number, email address, delivery address and billing address.
Order details: Products purchased, order history, preferred outlet, delivery or pickup instructions and custom cake requirements.
Communication details: Messages, feedback, reviews and conversations with our customer support team through WhatsApp, phone, email or chat.
Account details: Login information, saved addresses and preferences if you create an account.
Payment information: Payments are processed through our payment partners. Desert Forest does not store your complete card or banking details on its own servers.
Technical information: Device information, browser type, IP address, pages visited and website or app activity collected through cookies and similar technologies.
Marketing interactions: Your interaction with Desert Forest advertisements or campaigns on platforms such as Meta and Google, where such information is made available to us.

blocks.text: We collect information that is reasonably necessary for the purposes explained in this policy.

sections.heading: Why does Desert Forest use my information?

blocks.text: We use your information to:

items: Process, prepare and deliver your orders.
Confirm payments, pickups and deliveries.
Send important order and service updates.
Respond to questions, complaints, feedback and reviews.
Handle custom cake and special requests.
Improve our website, app, products and customer experience.
Run contests, loyalty programmes, surveys and promotions.
Send offers and marketing communications where you have given consent or where permitted by law.
Understand and measure the performance of our advertising campaigns.
Meet applicable legal, tax, accounting, food-safety and other regulatory requirements.

sections.heading: Does Desert Forest send marketing messages?

blocks.text: Yes, where permitted by law and, where required, with your consent.
We may send promotional communications through WhatsApp, SMS, email or push notifications.
You can stop promotional messages at any time by using the unsubscribe option provided, replying "STOP" on WhatsApp where supported, or contacting us.
Choosing not to receive marketing messages will not affect important communications about an order or service you have requested.

sections.heading: How does Desert Forest use WhatsApp?

blocks.text: If you provide your mobile number or contact us through WhatsApp, we may use it to communicate with you about orders, deliveries, customer support and other services.
Where applicable, we may also use WhatsApp to send promotional offers and campaign messages with your consent or as otherwise permitted by law.
You can opt out of promotional WhatsApp messages at any time.
Yes. We use cookies and similar technologies to make our website and app work better. They may help us:

items: Keep items in your cart.
Remember your preferences.
Understand how visitors use our website and app.
Measure and improve advertising campaigns.

blocks.text: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Some website features may not work as intended if certain cookies are disabled.

sections.heading: Does Desert Forest sell my personal information?

blocks.text: No.
Desert Forest does not sell or trade your personal information.

We may share limited information with trusted service providers when it is necessary to provide our services, process your order, operate our technology or carry out activities described in this policy.
Depending on how you use our services, we may share relevant information with:

items: Delivery partners — to deliver your order.
Payment providers — to process payments securely.
Technology and service providers — who support our website, app, customer service, analytics, communications and other business operations.
Advertising and marketing platforms — such as Meta or Google, where required to run or measure campaigns.
Government, regulatory or law-enforcement authorities — when required or permitted by law.

blocks.text: We aim to share only the information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

sections.heading: How does Desert Forest protect my information?

blocks.text: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, misuse, loss, alteration or disclosure.
These measures may include secure connections, access controls, security monitoring and secure payment processing through our service providers.
No website, app or online transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect the information entrusted to us.

sections.heading: How long does Desert Forest keep my information?

blocks.text: We do not keep personal information indefinitely without a reason.

We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide our services, maintain business and transaction records, meet legal, tax, accounting or food-safety requirements, resolve complaints or disputes, prevent misuse or fraud, and protect our legal rights.
When information is no longer required, we take appropriate steps to delete, erase or anonymise it, subject to applicable legal or regulatory requirements.
Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:

items: Access the personal information we hold about you.
Correct or update inaccurate or incomplete information.
Request deletion or erasure of your information where applicable.
Withdraw consent where your information is being processed based on consent.
Opt out of promotional communications.
Raise a privacy concern or complaint about how your information is handled.

blocks.text: Withdrawing consent does not affect processing that was already lawful before the withdrawal. We may also retain certain information where required or permitted by law.

sections.heading: How can I make a privacy request or complaint?

blocks.text: If you have a question about your personal information, want to exercise a privacy right, or have a privacy-related complaint, please contact us:
Desert Forest
Registered Office: Desert Forest, R.S. Puram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu – 641002
Email: hello@desertforest.in
We may ask you to verify your identity before processing certain requests. Desert Forest will handle privacy requests and complaints in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: How does Desert Forest handle children's information?

blocks.text: Our services are not intended to knowingly collect children's personal information without the consent required under applicable law.
Where children's personal information is processed, Desert Forest will follow applicable requirements relating to parental or lawful guardian consent and children's privacy.
We do not knowingly use children's information for prohibited tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising.

sections.heading: Is my information processed outside India?

blocks.text: Some of our technology, payment, analytics, communication or advertising service providers may process information outside India.

Where this happens, Desert Forest will take appropriate steps to comply with applicable Indian data protection requirements and any applicable restrictions or requirements prescribed by the Government of India.

sections.heading: What happens if there is a data security incident?

blocks.text: We take data security seriously.
If we become aware of a personal data breach or security incident, we will take appropriate steps to contain, investigate and address it.
Where required by applicable law, we will notify the relevant authorities and affected individuals in the manner and within the timelines prescribed by law.

sections.heading: What about third-party websites and services?

blocks.text: Our website or communications may contain links or integrations with third-party services, including payment providers, delivery services, social media, advertising and other platforms.
These third parties have their own privacy policies and terms. We encourage you to review them when using their services.
Yes.
We may update this Privacy Policy when our services, technology or legal requirements change.
Whenever we make changes, we will publish the updated version on this page and revise the Last Updated date. We encourage you to check this page periodically.
What information does Desert Forest collect?
Information such as your name, contact details, delivery details, order information, account information and relevant technical or marketing interaction data.
Why do we collect it?
To process orders, provide customer support, communicate with you, improve our services, run promotions and meet our legal obligations.
Does Desert Forest sell personal information?
No.
Can I stop marketing messages?
Yes. You can unsubscribe, reply "STOP" where supported, or contact us.
Can I ask Desert Forest to correct or delete my information?
Yes, subject to applicable law.
Who can I contact about privacy?
Email us at hello@desertforest.in or call +91 422 000 0000.
Desert Forest — Desserts from the forest, made in Coimbatore

intro.text: At Desert Forest, we understand that plans can change. We will always do our best to help with cancellation and refund requests, wherever possible.

This policy applies to orders placed through the Desert Forest website, app, WhatsApp, or any of our outlets. Since many of our products are prepared fresh and are perishable, some orders may not be eligible for cancellation or refund.
Please read the following policy carefully, especially if you are ordering a custom, personalised, or made-to-order cake.

blocks.text: Custom and Made-to-Order Cakes
Custom cakes are prepared specifically according to the customer's requirements, including the design, flavour, size, message, colours, and other requested details.
Once preparation of a custom or made-to-order cake has started, the order cannot be cancelled and the amount paid will not be refundable.

If you need to cancel a custom cake order, please contact us at least 24 hours before the scheduled delivery or pickup time. Cancellation requests received after this point may not be accepted if preparation has already started.
We recommend contacting us as early as possible if your plans change.
Standard Products
For standard, non-custom products, cancellation requests must be made at least 4 hours before the scheduled delivery or pickup time.
Cancellation requests made after preparation has started may not be accepted, as the product may already have been prepared specifically for the order.

For cancellations that are approved, a cancellation or processing fee of 25% of the order value may apply. This may be charged towards ingredients, preparation, packaging, or other costs already incurred for the order.
Where preparation of a custom or made-to-order product has already started, the order will not be eligible for cancellation or refund.
To request a cancellation, please contact us as soon as possible through:
Email: hello@desertforest.in
Please include your Order ID and the reason for your cancellation.
If you are contacting us by email, please use "Cancellation Request" as the subject line.

Submitting a cancellation request does not automatically mean that the order has been cancelled. The cancellation will be confirmed by Desert Forest after reviewing the order and its preparation status.
If a cancellation is approved and a refund is applicable, the refund will generally be made to the original payment method used for the order, unless otherwise agreed with the customer.
Refunds will be processed within 5-7 Business working days from the date the cancellation is approved.
Please note that the time taken for the amount to reflect in your account may also depend on your bank or payment service provider.

sections.heading: 5. Damaged, Incorrect, or Significantly Different Orders

blocks.text: We take care to ensure that every order reaches you in good condition and matches what you ordered.
If your order arrives damaged, incorrect, or significantly different from the product you ordered, please contact us within a reasonable time of delivery or pickup.

Where possible, please share photographs of the product and packaging along with your Order ID. After reviewing the issue, Desert Forest may provide an appropriate resolution, which may include a replacement, refund, or store credit, depending on the circumstances.

sections.heading: 6. Delivery Issues Caused by the Customer

blocks.text: An order may not be eligible for a refund solely because delivery could not be completed due to:

items: An incorrect or incomplete delivery address provided by the customer.
The customer being unavailable to receive the order.
The customer not responding to calls or delivery-related communication.
Any other issue caused by the customer that prevents successful delivery.

blocks.text: We will make reasonable efforts to contact the customer and complete the delivery wherever possible.
In certain situations, Desert Forest may need to cancel an order. This may happen due to reasons such as:

items: Product or ingredient unavailability.
An outlet being unable to fulfil the order.
A technical, pricing, or system error.
Other circumstances that prevent us from fulfilling the order.

blocks.text: If Desert Forest cancels an order for such reasons, the customer will be eligible for a full refund of the amount paid for that order.

Custom cakes require advance planning and preparation. Once our team begins working on your custom cake, ingredients, materials, designs, and preparation time may already have been committed specifically for your order.
For this reason, a custom cake cannot be cancelled or refunded once preparation has started.
If you need to make a change to your custom cake or cancel it, please contact us before preparation begins. We will review the request based on the stage of preparation and the nature of the order.
Desert Forest may update this Cancellation and Refund Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, processes, or applicable requirements.
The policy applicable to your order will generally be the version that was in effect when the order was placed.
If you have any questions about cancellations, refunds, or your order, please contact us:
Email: hello@desertforest.in
We recommend contacting us as early as possible for any cancellation or order-related request so that our team can assist you appropriately.
